fee_notes: Royalty is 7% weekly gross sales or $250/week minimum (whichever greater); may not exceed 10%. Creative Fund currently 1% gross sales or $250/month minimum, may increase to 3%. Local advertising: new locations $5,000/month first 6 months, then 7% or $2,100/month min for years 1-3, then 3.5% or $1,500/month min for mature locations. Software fee $299/month (Shop-Ware).
